name: Browser Automation
instructions: Drives the built-in Browser tab for this thread. Open one http or https page, then use snapshot refs — whole numbers — to click, fill, type, press, select, and scroll. Fill writes text. One page per window. Close stops driving and leaves the page open.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open the built-in Browser tab for this thread and load an address. http and https open. A bare name such as example.com loads over https, and a local host such as localhost:3000 loads over http. One page per window.

tools.name: browser_status
tools.description: Read the built-in Browser tab this thread is driving: url, title, and whether that tab is showing.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Read the page in the built-in Browser tab. Each control has a whole-number ref for click, fill, and select. Refs last until the next snapshot or navigation.

tools.name: browser_goto
tools.description: Load another http or https address in this thread's Browser tab. A bare name and a local host follow the same rule as browser_open. Old refs are gone.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Go back in this thread's Browser tab.

tools.name: browser_forward
tools.description: Go forward in this thread's Browser tab.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click the control with this whole-number ref from the latest snapshot of the built-in Browser tab.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Write text into the control with this whole-number ref. The text is the argument. There is no file.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into the focused control in the built-in Browser tab.

tools.name: browser_press
tools.description: Press a key in the focused control: enter, escape, tab, space, backspace, delete, up, down, left, right, home, end, pageup, pagedown, or one character.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Choose an option in the select with this whole-number ref, by its value or its label.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the built-in Browser tab by dy pixels. Positive is down.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Stop driving the built-in Browser tab. The page stays open for the person.
